notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
[b]Changes[/b]
There is now a small meter under the difficulty to let you know when it's about to increase. This is only a small visual aid as the difficulty is constantly increasing by small increments regardless.

The description for the AM Rifle now lets you know it kills under 15% HP at level 1

[b]Fixes[/b]
The Chain item was not drawing properly if the player was jumping, this should now be fixed.

Defeating Valadir, the Patrician in the Zerpian Capital stage was not rewarding a stage clear. Now it does!

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
[b]Additions[/b]
Mouse Inputs now accepted, can be set in Controls menu
Player indicator appears when hit to help visibility

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug where you could level up after dying

[b]Balance[/b]
[u]Song's Aerial Attack[/u]
This is an extremely spammable move that even allows you to change direction in mid air. The mobility and speed make it fun to use repeatedly, but overall it was too powerful. The hitbox has been reduced and changed to a circular shape from a rectangle shape. In addition, the hitbox starts higher, making it harder to hit a row of enemies on the ground all at once. Her recovery from this move was increased by a single frame.
